checkpoints.description: [1/5] Plan: zero-dependency focus timer with a themed static UI under the aikit ui guard

impact_assessment.why: exercise the UI contract, snapshot and style gates on a fresh project with a real, reviewable UI surface
impact_assessment.benefits: a usable local focus timer; a worked example of a non-React zero-dependency UI contract with an inventory proof and theme tokens
impact_assessment.risks: contract: ui.json surface and protected paths must match the real tree or verify refuses every edit; dependency: stdlib only, no npm or test runner beyond unittest; concurrency: session store written from a single-threaded http.server, one writer at a time; state: sessions.json must survive power loss mid-write
impact_assessment.mitigation: scaffold the contract from the real tree after the UI exists; atomic temp+fsync+replace writes with a schema version and refusal on unknown versions; unit tests under 10ms with no spawns and integration tests under 350ms

checkpoints.description: [4/5] Domain, store, UI surface, server and README built; 30 tests pass, 4/4 project gates pass, app dogfooded over HTTP; checklists: passed

[5/5] Dogfood runner added (19/19 steps, golden path + chaos), UI proofs probed with 7 hostile edits (all caught), ADR-001..003 recorded; 5/5 gates pass; checklists: passed; UI begin/verify/finish blocked: user withheld commit authorization

[5/5] Full UI guard lifecycle exercised in a disposable jail: 8/8 verify probes and 11/11 lifecycle probes as expected; ported the verified focus-ring edit, ignored bytecode, fixed latent README tree drift; 5/5 gates pass; checklists: passed; still uncommitted by user instruction
[5/5] Delivery authorized by the user: re-verified 30 tests and 5/5 gates, staging the initial tree, recording bootstrap UI surface evidence, then publishing public; checklists: passed
